tool: Agent OS MO2 + DevBench closed-loop runtime harness

invocation.transport: Agent OS host worker -> MO2 documented CLI -> Skyrim/SKSE -> DevBench loopback REST

inputs: DevBench installed in the disposable test profile
destructive_actions: creates a disposable copy of the configured MO2 template profile
may copy save fixtures into that disposable profile
runs typed test actions only against the disposable runtime
requests game shutdown after the scenario
human_checks: visual/screenshot-only judgments remain advisory unless paired with deterministic state
unsupported DevBench tools/operators remain needs-review rather than being guessed

coverage.description: Composite Windows runtime adapter that owns the full isolated session lifecycle: prepare disposable MO2 profile, launch configured Skyrim executable, wait for fresh DevBench identity, run event-driven typed scenario/probes, evaluate G19/G20/G26 evidence, request clean shutdown, capture evidence deltas, and clean up or retain the fixture.
known_gaps: G21 save-migration proof requires a dedicated typed migration flow
screenshot/vision verdicts are not yet normalized into deterministic assertions
frame traces require an external configured producer
runtime execution requires a Windows machine with the configured MO2/Skyrim/DevBench toolchain
coverage.denominator_probe: Unique session token + DevBench pid/port/exe/vr identity before/after + scenario transcript + assertion probes + configured crash/log evidence + cleanup result.

requires_confirmation_for: any configuration that points writable roots outside the dedicated runtime workspace
safety.sandbox_or_scope: All host-side writes must remain under worker-config allowed_mutation_roots; pre-existing conflicting MO2/Skyrim processes are rejected; stale/cross-session observer evidence is rejected by session token and timestamp.

verification.version_probe: Pin Python, MO2, Skyrim runtime/SKSE, DevBench and configured executable versions/hashes in the project toolchain lock.
verification.output_readback: Validate skyrim-runtime-session-result-v1. Runtime PASS requires successful typed assertions, G19 evidence, applicable G20/G21 evidence, stable DevBench instance identity, clean process boundary and cleanup.

ai.context_cost_notes: Prefer normalized session/observation JSON and load raw logs only for diagnosis.

evidence.notes: Composite uses verified MO2 command-line behavior from ModOrganizer2/modorganizer and verified DevBench REST/scenario/health behavior from alandtse/devbench. It exists because DAG adapters are alternatives, while MO2 lifecycle isolation and DevBench in-game observation are complementary responsibilities.
